contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP] C CLAVDIVS [AVG] ; R/ LIB[ERT AVG]

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Cunetio nos 2164-2166, mint of Rome, Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right, bearded. Obverse inscription: [IMP] C CLAVDIVS [AVG]. Reverse description: Draped figure standing left with vertical spear and modius, X in right field. Reverse inscription: LIB[ERT AVG]. Diameter: 20.9mm, Weight: 2.05gms, die axis: 6
